title: Commitment (v0)
description: Formed only after a match_proposal (docs/spec/01 §P11) has been approved by BOTH sides and funds captured. This is an AGREEMENT, explicitly not the final step — completion is the separate P8 dual-approval-plus-evidence gate. Immutable terms + signatures make it the audit record disputes (docs/spec/05) are adjudicated on.

demand_ref.description: The Intent OR Coalition this commitment satisfies.

demand_agents.description: More than one when the demand side is a coalition.

terms_snapshot.description: Final agreed terms, immutable once recorded.

detail.description: Category-specific agreed detail (e.g. per-member drop points).

escrow.description: Escrow state (§P8), held in PLATFORM CUSTODY — not a third-party clearing exchange (§P11). Money is held, never moved, until Fulfillment records consumer approval AND provider approval AND platform verification, OR a dispute (docs/spec/05) is resolved by the operator's DisputeResolver. Raising a dispute unconditionally freezes this to 'disputed' — no payout occurs until resolution.

provider_stake.description: Optional additional deposit captured from the provider at the same moment (§P11: "each party putting money").

status.description: 'confirmed' means agreement reached + funds captured — NOT completion (§P11). Completion is tracked on the Fulfillment record, not here.

fulfillment_window.description: The service's own duration — a minute to multiple days (docs/spec/05). Omitted for categories that treat fulfillment as effectively instantaneous. A dispute may be raised by either party at any point inside this window, not only at its end.

mandate_refs.description: The mandate(s) authorizing this commitment. Runtime MUST verify total_price is within every referenced mandate's budget_ceiling before forming the commitment.

signatures.description: Both sides sign the terms_snapshot, making it non-repudiable.
